English: Stone Tool Shed
A basic lean-to or tented shelter where simple stone and bone weapons are crafted with crude tools. Enables the clan to begin arming itself in the wild steppe.
Wooden Weapons Bench
A rough-hewn workbench under canvas, where skilled hands carve clubs, spears, and bows from local wood. The first step to arming your horde with more than stone implements.
Basic Forge
A primitive forge, often little more than a pit and bellows, but sufficient to shape iron for arrowheads and spear tips.
Iron Weapons Stand
A mobile rack of iron swords, axes, and arrowheads forged by veteran smiths, allowing the horde to field more professional warriors.
Composite Bow Workshop
A specialized tent where master bowyers craft the renowned river nomad composite bows, famed for their power and range.
Lance Makers Tent
A mobile smithy and armorers pavilion, producing weighted lances and reinforced arms for the elite cavalry of the horde.
Fine Blade Smithy
A semi-permanent forge and workshop for the creation of decorated swords and axes, arming the hordes champions and officers.
Ornamented Armory
A grand armory tent, lined with richly decorated weapons and armor, boosting prestige and attracting ambitious warriors to your banner.
Master Weapons Pavilion
A resplendent mobile pavilion, staffed by master smiths crafting the finest river nomad arms and armor, ensuring your warriors are the best equipped on the plains.
Nomad Arsenal
A legendary rolling arsenal, housing the finest weaponsmiths, bowyers, and armorers. The heart of every great khans horde.
River Nomad Arsenal
A legendary rolling arsenal, housing the finest weaponsmiths, bowyers, and armorers among the river nomads. The heart of every great khans horde.
